transcript: Client needs a mobile-friendly fitness studio website with class listings, trainer profiles and contact details. Online payments are excluded from phase one.
Client wants a local service directory with plumber and electrician profiles, category search and location search. Hosting is undecided.
Client wants an existing business website redesigned for mobile devices. They also want appointment booking, but the booking provider and current platform are unknown.
Client requests a restaurant website with a menu page, opening hours, location details and a contact form. They have not provided branding.
Client requests an online course website with course pages and student registration. Payment integration is not confirmed.
Client project: Restaurant Website. A restaurant needs a menu, opening hours, location map and contact form. Branding is undecided.
Client project: Online Course Platform. A training provider needs course pages, student registration and progress tracking. Payment requirements are undecided.
Client project: Portfolio Website. A photographer needs a responsive portfolio, gallery, biography and enquiry form.
Client project: Booking Website. A salon needs service listings and appointment booking. The booking provider is not selected.
Client project: Ecommerce Website. A shop wants product pages, search, cart and checkout. Payment gateway and shipping rules are undecided.
Client project: School Website. A school needs admissions information, staff profiles, events and a contact form.
Client project: Medical Clinic Website. A clinic wants doctor profiles, opening hours and appointment requests. Privacy requirements need clarification.
Client project: Real Estate Directory. A property agency needs property listings, location filters and enquiry forms. Listing data is not ready.
Client project: Nonprofit Website. A nonprofit needs its mission, projects, volunteer registration and donation functionality. Donation provider is undecided.
Client project: Travel Website. A travel agency needs destination pages, tour packages and enquiry forms. Booking and payment integrations are undecided.
Client project: Redesign Project. A client wants a mobile-friendly redesign of an existing website. Platform, migration and launch date are unknown.
Client project: Membership Website. A community wants member profiles, login and restricted content. Subscription and payment requirements are not confirmed.
Client project: Event Website. An event organizer needs event pages, schedules, speaker profiles and registration. Ticket payment is undecided.
Client project: Service Marketplace. A client wants customer and provider accounts, searchable services and reviews. Moderation and payment rules need confirmation.
Client project: Incomplete Brief. Client says they want a website but has not decided the purpose, audience, features, budget or deadline.
